method_limits: naming is a basename match in the file text; a note named through a composed or imported path is not counted as naming
a producer's faces are the string literals it carries that resolve under results/; a path assembled from parts at call time is reported in `unprobeable` as a template, never silently dropped

digest evidence is a value equal to the note's current sha256 (full or >=12 hex prefix) or a prereg/note key carrying an ISO as-of date; a digest of a different version of the note does not match, and that is the measurement
only JSON faces are inspected for digest fields; md/csv/txt faces are probed for existence and counted, not parsed

a study is graded on the faces of its own producer (the file whose basename carries the study slug); when no such file names the note the grading falls back to every naming producer and says so in producer_basis
near_miss_faces are published beside the classes: a face that names a prereg field or the study stem but carries no digest is the evidence that the claim is made in prose rather than pinned
